_comment: Grading rubric for the homework evaluation agent. Mirrors wiki/Homework-Grading-Agent.md. Scale bands are shown to the model at grading time AND used in feedback, so a score always comes with a meaning.

1.meaning: Attempted, but key elements are missing or wrong; does not meet the task's basic ask

2.meaning: Partial attempt; more gaps than hits

3.meaning: Meets the basic bar, but inconsistently

5.meaning: Exceeds the ask; good enough to show other students as an example

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.measured_by: Filler-word rate in the transcript, plus sampled video frames

vocabulary.label: Vocabulary
vocabulary.measured_by: Transcript checked against the module's word list

tone.label: Tone
tone.measured_by: Audio and frames, read against this module's own Instruction text

hand_gesture.label: Hand Gesture
hand_gesture.measured_by: Sampled frames only - the weakest signal of the five

speed.label: Speed
speed.measured_by: Computed words-per-minute from transcript timing - measured, not guessed

completion.label: Completion
completion.checks: Was the full task attempted - every vocabulary item, every action point?

accuracy.label: Accuracy
accuracy.checks: Are the meanings, translations and facts correct against the module's article?

comprehension.label: Comprehension
comprehension.checks: Do the action points show understanding in the student's own words, rather than copying line for line?

presentation.label: Presentation
presentation.checks: Is it readable and organised - clear layout, the expected structure?

rating_weights._comment: Simple means by default. Overall is a 50/50 blend of the two artifact ratings; video and note ratings are always reported separately as well.

abstain._comment: When the model is below this confidence, the parameter is not_assessed and drops out of the average. It is never scored low instead.

trend._comment: Compared against the student's own history for the same skill_type - never against other students.

teacher_flags._comment: Flags route a teacher's attention. They do NOT gate publication - grading publishes automatically. Keep the combined flag rate near 10% of submissions or the triage value is lost.

fairness._comment: Not optional polish. These prevent the agent from penalising students for things that are not their performance.
